title: Sea Island Cotton Crew Tee
description: Spun from long-staple Sea Island cotton and knitted to a dense 220 GSM, this crew neck holds its shape wash after wash. The self-fabric collar band is bound rather than taped, so it sits flat against the neck for years.

title: Pima Cotton Henley
description: A four-button henley in brushed Peruvian Pima, finished with a reinforced placket that resists gaping. Soft enough to wear alone, substantial enough to layer under tailoring.
keyFeatures: Regular fit with a slight taper

title: Mercerised Slub Polo
description: Mercerised slub yarn gives this polo a subtle lustre and a dry hand that reads more knitwear than jersey. The ribbed collar is knitted to shape rather than cut, so it never curls.

title: Kingsley Oxford Shirt
description: Our house oxford, woven on slow looms from two-ply cotton and garment-washed for immediate softness. The button-down collar carries a deliberate roll that holds through a full day.

title: Cotton-Linen Resort Shirt
description: An open-weave cotton-linen blend cut with a relaxed camp collar for warm evenings. It creases the way good linen should and softens with every wash.

title: Egyptian Cotton Poplin Dress Shirt
description: Giza cotton poplin with a fine, cool hand and a crisp finish that survives a full week of wear. Cut with a semi-spread collar sized for both a tie and an open neck.
keyFeatures: Long tail for a secure tuck

title: Silk-Blend Camp Collar Shirt
description: Silk and cotton blended into a fluid, faintly lustrous cloth that moves without clinging. The camp collar is cut wide and low for an easy, unfussy line.
keyFeatures: Silk-cotton blend with a fluid drape

title: Selvedge Straight-Leg Denim
description: Fourteen-ounce selvedge denim woven on shuttle looms, cut straight from hip to hem. It arrives rigid and fades to your own shape over the first hundred wears.

title: Japanese Raw Denim Slim
description: Okayama-woven raw denim with a deep indigo warp that breaks into high-contrast fades. Slim through the thigh with a clean taper below the knee.
keyFeatures: Slim fit with a knee-down taper
Hidden rivets at the back pockets

title: Stone-Washed Tapered Denim
description: A softened, ready-to-wear stone wash over comfort-stretch denim. Tapered through the leg without restricting the seat.

title: Garment-Dyed Chino Shorts
description: Piece-dyed after construction so the twill takes on a lived-in depth of colour from the first wear. Cut to sit just above the knee.
keyFeatures: Slant hip and buttoned back pockets

title: Linen Drawstring Shorts
description: Pure European linen with a covered elastic waist and a flat drawcord, built for heat. Loose through the leg with a clean, unbulky finish.
keyFeatures: Covered elastic waist with flat drawcord

title: Hand-Welted Leather Derby
description: A hand-welted derby on full-grain calfskin, built so the sole can be replaced rather than the shoe. The open lacing accommodates a higher instep.
keyFeatures: Leather sole with a rubber top piece

title: Suede Penny Loafers
description: Unlined suede loafers that mould to the foot within a week. The strap is hand-stitched and the last is cut narrow through the waist for a close fit.
keyFeatures: Breaks in without a break-in period

title: Italian Leather Sneakers
description: Minimal low-tops in vegetable-tanned Italian calfskin on a cupsole that stays quiet under tailoring. Tonal stitching keeps the silhouette clean.

title: Egyptian Cotton Ribbed Socks — Three Pack
description: Fine-gauge Egyptian cotton with a hand-linked toe seam you cannot feel through a dress shoe. Sold as a set of three in complementary tones.

title: Merino Wool Dress Socks
description: Extra-fine merino knitted at 200 needles for a smooth, non-itch surface. Warm in winter and surprisingly temperate in a warm room.

title: Quick-Dry Swim Shorts
description: Recycled quick-dry shell with a mesh liner and a fully bonded back pocket. Dries in the time it takes to walk back from the water.

title: Linen Beach Overshirt
description: A loose, sheer-weave linen overshirt made to be thrown over swim shorts. Deliberately oversized with dropped shoulders.

title: Merino Wool Overcoat
description: A single-breasted overcoat in double-faced merino, half-canvassed through the chest so it holds its line without stiffness. Cut long enough to cover a suit jacket.

title: Suede Leather Bomber
description: Goat suede with a nap that deepens with handling, set on ribbed merino trims. The lightest serious outerwear we make.
keyFeatures: Ribbed merino collar, cuffs and hem

title: Quilted Field Jacket
description: Diamond-quilted shell over a light down-alternative fill, cut with a longer body for real cover. Cord-trimmed collar and a full storm placket.
keyFeatures: Full storm placket over the zip

title: Supima Cotton Boxy Tee
description: A boxy tee in compact-spun Supima that holds a clean line across the shoulder. Cropped just enough to sit at the waistband.
keyFeatures: Boxy cut with a set shoulder

title: Silk-Touch Modal Tee
description: Micro-modal jersey with a cool, fluid hand that skims rather than clings. The neckline is cut wide and finished with a rolled edge.

title: Ribbed Knit Long-Sleeve Top
description: A fine 2x2 rib that stretches in one direction and recovers fully. Long in the sleeve, close through the body, and easy under a jacket.
keyFeatures: Flatlock seams lie invisible under layers

title: Mulberry Silk Shirt
description: Nineteen-momme mulberry silk with enough weight to fall properly from the shoulder. French seams throughout, so the inside is as finished as the outside.
keyFeatures: Relaxed fit with a soft shoulder

title: Cotton Poplin Boyfriend Shirt
description: A borrowed-from-him poplin shirt with a longer body and a soft, unfused collar. Crisp on the first wear, softer by the fifth.

title: Linen Tunic Shirt
description: Washed European linen cut long and loose with side vents. Designed for heat and for layering over slim trousers.

title: High-Rise Straight Denim
description: Rigid cotton denim cut high at the waist and straight to the ankle. Structured enough to hold the seat without stretch giving out.

title: Wide-Leg Cropped Denim
description: A wide, clean leg cropped above the ankle to sit well with a heel or a flat. Cut from a dry denim that keeps its structure.
keyFeatures: High rise with a curved waistband

title: Sculpt Skinny Denim
description: Power-stretch denim with a bonded inner panel that shapes without compressing. Recovers fully overnight — no knee bagging.

title: Tailored Linen Shorts
description: Pressed linen shorts with a proper waistband, front pleats and a clean interior finish. Tailoring details on a warm-weather cut.
keyFeatures: Slant pockets and a jetted back pocket

title: Denim Cuffed Shorts
description: Rigid denim shorts with a permanent turn-up and a relaxed seat. They fade honestly across the front of the thigh.

title: Bias-Cut Silk Slip Dress
description: Cut on the true bias from sand-washed silk so it traces the body without gripping. Adjustable straps and a fully enclosed hem.

title: Handwoven Chanderi Maxi Dress
description: Chanderi handwoven on pit looms, light enough to read as air and structured enough to hold a column silhouette. Lined in cotton voile.
keyFeatures: Each panel varies slightly by hand

title: Crepe Midi Wrap Dress
description: A true wrap in a matte crepe with enough body to stay closed. Self-tie waist adjusts across a wide range.
keyFeatures: Machine washable on a delicate cycle

title: Pleated Georgette Gown
description: Hand-set micro-pleats through a georgette skirt that carries movement all the way to the floor. Boned bodice, no visible closure.
keyFeatures: Floor length with a slight sweep

title: Leather Block-Heel Sandals
description: A 65 mm block heel balanced so the weight sits under the arch, not the ball. Vegetable-tanned straps soften to the foot in days.

title: Almond-Toe Leather Pumps
description: An almond last that gives the toes room while keeping a long line. Built on a steel shank so the arch holds through a full evening.

title: Soft Leather Ballet Flats
description: Unlined nappa flats that fold flat into a bag. The elasticated topline keeps them on without cutting in.

title: Cashmere-Blend Ankle Socks
description: Cashmere blended with fine merino for warmth that stays light. The cuff is knitted loose so it never leaves a mark.

title: Sheer Rib Trouser Socks
description: A fine sheer rib that disappears inside a loafer or a trouser hem. Enough elastane to stay up all day.

title: Double-Faced Wool Coat
description: Double-faced wool bonded without lining, so the coat is finished on both faces and half the usual weight. The edges are hand-closed.
keyFeatures: Wrap front with a self belt

title: Cropped Leather Biker Jacket
description: Lamb nappa with an asymmetric zip and a cropped body that sits at the natural waist. Soft from the first wear.

title: Quilted Silk Bomber
description: Silk shell over a light quilted fill — warmth without volume. Ribbed trims keep the silhouette contained.

title: Organic Cotton Play Tee
description: GOTS-certified organic cotton, washed soft before it ever reaches a child. Shoulder seams are taped so the neckline survives being pulled over a head a hundred times.

title: Striped Long-Sleeve Tee
description: Yarn-dyed stripes that will not bleed in the wash, on a mid-weight organic jersey. Cuffs are ribbed to stay put over small hands.

title: Mandarin Collar Cotton Shirt
description: A soft mandarin collar shirt in handloom cotton — smart enough for a wedding, comfortable enough to keep on afterwards.

title: Chambray Button-Down Shirt
description: Lightweight chambray with a button-down collar that stays neat without ironing. Cut with extra room across the back.

title: Twill Pull-On Shorts
description: Cotton twill shorts on a full elastic waist with an internal drawcord — easy for small hands, secure once on.
keyFeatures: Cotton twill with a soft hand
Full elastic waist with internal drawcord

title: Linen Blend Shorts
description: A cotton-linen blend that breathes through hot afternoons and dries quickly after them.

title: Muslin Two-Piece Co-Ord Set
description: Double-gauze muslin, breathable and light, in a matched top and trouser. It gets softer with every single wash.

title: Knit Sweatshirt & Jogger Set
description: Brushed-back loopknit in a two-piece set that survives daily wear and daily washing. Cuffs and waist are ribbed to hold.

title: Organic Cotton Dungaree
description: Adjustable straps and a roomy bib in soft organic cotton twill, built to be handed down rather than thrown out.

title: Quilted Winter Jumpsuit
description: A quilted all-in-one with fold-back cuffs and a two-way zip, warm enough for a cold morning without restricting movement.
keyFeatures: Fold-back cuffs at hand and foot

title: Full-Grain Leather Dress Belt
description: A single length of full-grain bridle leather with a solid brass buckle — no bonded filler, no split hide. It will outlast the trousers.

title: Reversible Calfskin Belt
description: Two finished calfskin faces on one belt with a rotating buckle, so black and tan travel as a single item.
keyFeatures: Black on one side, tan on the other

title: Automatic Sapphire Dress Watch
description: A 38 mm automatic with a domed sapphire crystal and a 42-hour reserve. Thin enough to disappear under a shirt cuff.
colour: brushed steel with a black dial

title: Slim Quartz Leather-Strap Watch
description: A quiet 36 mm quartz on a vegetable-tanned strap. Applied indices, no date window, nothing extraneous.
colour: brushed steel with a white dial

title: Steel Bracelet Chronograph
description: A three-register chronograph on a tapered steel bracelet with screwed links. Substantial without being oversized.
colour: brushed steel with a black dial

title: Full-Grain Bifold Wallet
description: Vegetable-tanned full-grain leather, skived thin at the fold so it never bulks in a pocket. Hand-stitched with waxed linen thread.
keyFeatures: Six card slots and two note sections

title: Saffiano Leather Cardholder
description: Cross-hatched saffiano that resists scratches and water. Four slots and a centre pocket — deliberately minimal.
keyFeatures: Four card slots plus centre pocket
Slim enough for a front pocket

title: Zip-Around Travel Wallet
description: A zip-around organiser sized for a passport, boarding passes and multiple currencies, in soft milled leather.

title: 18K Gold-Plated Signet Ring
description: A heavy brass core under thick 18K plating, with a flat face left blank for engraving.
keyFeatures: Thick 18K gold plating over solid brass
Supplied in a lined presentation box

title: Freshwater Pearl Drop Earrings
description: Hand-matched freshwater pearls on sterling silver posts. No two pairs carry exactly the same lustre.
colour: natural white pearl on sterling silver

title: Sterling Silver Chain Necklace
description: A solid 925 sterling chain with a hand-soldered lobster clasp, weighted to sit flat against the collarbone.
